Virtual Display Driver 25.7.23, driver-only packages, unmodified:
https://github.com/VirtualDrivers/Virtual-Display-Driver/releases/tag/25.7.23

- x64/   from VirtualDisplayDriver-x86.Driver.Only.zip (the "x86" package is the amd64 build)
- arm64/ from VirtualDisplayDriver-ARM64.Driver.Only.zip

Catalogs are signed by SignPath Foundation. Checksums in SHA256SUMS.
The vdd_settings.xml files are only used as templates; the app writes its own
copy (6 screens, its own resolution list) when it installs the driver.
